changes.text: The initials tile colour now comes from the shared `CHART_PALETTE` (`--ss-accent`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-magenta`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-green`) instead of a private list using `--ss-primary`, `--ss-purple` and `--ss-lime`, so a theme flip or an imported custom palette recolours it. A given `name` keeps the same palette position; the order and length are stable API.

New component: a square avatar that shows an image (`src`, `alt`) or up to two initials taken from `name`, on a background colour hashed deterministically from the name. It falls back to the initials if the image fails to load, exposes `name` once through `role="img"` and `aria-label`, and takes `size` (`sm`, `md`, `lg`).
